topic: This week in AI: the top 5 stories you need to know
post:
This week in AI: a record IPO, a record quarter, and a reminder that AI is personal. 🎢
Here are the top 5 stories you need to know.

1️⃣ Anthropic goes public
Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, above its planned range, and closed its first day on Nasdaq at about $97, per Forbes and NPR. 📈

2️⃣ Nvidia's numbers roll on
In its first report since its CEO's exit, Nvidia posted about $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue, roughly double a year earlier. The interim CEO said Jensen Huang won't return.

3️⃣ New OpenAI models
OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol. Coverage of its safety report says both were rated "Critical" for cybersecurity risk.

4️⃣ AI agents get a wallet
OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet lets its agents make purchases for you, with your approval on each one. 💳

5️⃣ AI as a friend
A Gallup survey of young people aged 15-22 across 16 countries found a median of 33% have used AI as a companion or friend. 🫂

Why it matters:
AI is now big money, critical infrastructure, and part of people's personal lives, all at the same time.

Practical takeaway:
Pick the one story that touches your life most, and talk about it with someone this weekend. 💬

Which story matters most to you? 👇
